title: Adrasteia Stage-A adoption
objective: Establish the Adrasteia portable representation baseline across all Fates. Each Fate adopts the project-runtime-contracts@0.4.0 package at protocol 1.4.0.
contractChanges: All consumer Fates adopt the contracts package
requiredConsumerTests: Each consumer Fate validates contract adoption via its own test suite
integrationTests: All consumer Fates reference the same protocol version (1.4.0)
All consumer Fates reference compatible contract package versions
stopConditions: All Fates have adopted the Adrasteia contracts package
All required commits are pushed and recorded; any missing checkpoint tag is explicitly recorded as provisional
fates-lock.json is updated with exact checkpoints
Compatibility matrix reflects the completed slice

finalEvidence.acceptance: All five Fates have adopted the Adrasteia portable representation baseline. Four Fates have sealed tagged checkpoints; Moirae Code has a pushed but untagged commit. The integration checkpoint is provisional until Moirae Code has a verified annotated tag. This is an inspection-only integration — no governed execution, memory handoff, durable recovery, or content preflight is available.
limitations: Inspection only — no runtime integration exercised
